description: Control Sony INZONE headsets from the Windows tray, the command line and Stream Deck
notes: Up to 1.1.2, the update button inside the app installs the setup.exe version alongside this one. Update those with 'scoop update openinzone' instead, with the tray closed.
Later versions: the update button updates through Scoop. 'scoop update openinzone' also works, with the tray closed.
The Stream Deck plugin is not part of this package: Settings > Plugin downloads it.
